caption:
A business visa is not permission to work. Confusing the two causes real problems.

It covers meetings, conferences, negotiations and site visits — representing your UAE employer or your own company abroad. It does not cover being employed by a company in that country, or being paid locally.

The documentation differs too: host invitation, employer letter from here, and a purpose matching what you will actually do.

slides.headline: A BUSINESS VISA IS NOT PERMISSION TO WORK.
slides.sub: Confusing the two causes real problems.
slides.note: It covers meetings, conferences, negotiations and site visits. It does not cover local employment or local pay.

slides.answer: THE TEST IS WHO PAYS YOU.
slides.body: Representing your UAE employer abroad is business travel. Being employed or paid by a company in that country is work — and it needs a different permission entirely.
slides.note: The line is clearer than people assume, and officers know exactly where it sits.

slides.headline: WHAT A BUSINESS FILE NEEDS
items: An invitation letter from the host company
A letter from your UAE employer
A stated purpose matching what you will actually do
Evidence of your ongoing role here

slides.headline: THE INCONSISTENCY OFFICERS LOOK FOR
slides.never: Attach a business purpose to what is really a leisure trip because you think it processes faster. The supporting documents will not match the story, and that mismatch is precisely what gets caught.
slides.instead: Describe the trip accurately and apply in the correct category. Accuracy is faster than cleverness, every time.
